description: Breaks planted in day1.log by 'fixscan generate'. A scan of that file must report exactly these findings (ruleId + clOrdId), no more and no fewer. clOrdId is the first ClOrdID of the order's amend/cancel chain; null for session-level findings.

findings.note: Notional 15.5m exceeds the broker's 10m per-order limit
NewOrderSingle sent with Side(54)=Z, refused by the broker's FIX engine
Broker application could not route the order
Heartbeat from BROKERX with a wrong CheckSum(10)
Cancel request crossed with the final fill
Two messages from BROKERX missing; recovered with ResendRequest and SequenceReset-GapFill
BROKERY silent for 95s, then three messages missing; ResendRequest never answered
Two fills of 300 against an order for 500
Second fill reports LastQty 300 but CumQty 600 after a first fill of 200
First fill of 200 sent twice with the same ExecID
Cancel request refers to an OrigClOrdID that is not in the log
...and the broker rejects it as an unknown order
Fill of 100 reported two seconds after the order was canceled
Amend chain: the final cancel is rejected as too late (closing auction)
...and the order is then filled 600 of 1500 with no terminal state
